question: o04
q: How many people tapped on at Central station last Friday?

transcript.answer:
I can't get that number. My tools only cover Opal tap-ons aggregated by commercial centre (Sydney CBD, Chatswood, Parramatta and so on), by month, and not by individual station on a given day. Central isn't one of the centres, and I don't have last Friday's figures.

The closest thing I have is the Sydney CBD evening figure. For 3pm–7pm, the average Tue–Thu tap-ons per day were about 262,200 in August 2026 and about 255,900 in September 2026. That covers all CBD stations combined, weekdays Tue–Thu, not Central alone or Fridays.

For station-level daily counts, TfNSW publishes raw Opal tap data on its Open Data portal, which would have the Central figures. I can't query that from here.
